exercises.prompt: Select the correct relative clause for an INDEFINITE antecedent ('a book that I read'):
exercises.explanation: Indefinite antecedents omit the relative pronoun الَّذِي while retaining the resumptive pronoun ـهُ (al-ʿāʾid).

feedback.rule: Definite antecedent → uses الَّذِي; indefinite antecedent → omits الَّذِي.
feedback.commonError: Inserting الَّذِي after an indefinite noun.

exercises.prompt: What is the grammatical function of ـهِ in البَيْتُ الَّذِي سَكَنْتُ فِيهِ?
choices: Al-ʿāʾid (returning resumptive pronoun referring back to البَيْتُ)
exercises.answer: Al-ʿāʾid (returning resumptive pronoun referring back to البَيْتُ)
exercises.explanation: Al-ʿāʾid links the relative clause back to the antecedent noun in agreement with its gender and number.

feedback.rule: A relative clause requires a returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) when the antecedent is an object or prepositional object.
